summary: KB Editor redesign fully tested. All features working correctly. Backend: 14/14 tests pass - Global Docs Settings (GET/PUT with auth), article description field, published=false default for new articles, article validation (title/slug required, duplicate slug rejection). Frontend: 28/28 tests pass - page load with auto-selection of first article, Document section (Title*, Description, Slug* with URL preview, Category/Subcategory dropdowns), Draft/Publish toggle with correct default, Save button validation (disabled when Title or Slug empty), WYSIWYG rich text editor (TipTap) with Insert menu (11 component options), Heading dropdown (H1-H6), formatting toolbar, Global Docs Settings modal with all 7 fields. Public /docs page continues to work correctly (no regression).
seed_data_creation: None needed - existing articles used for testing. Test data created during tests is cleaned up automatically.
context_for_next_testing_agent: KB Editor redesign complete.
